__TOC__
'''DAT v26''' is a version of the '''DAT''' terrain files: the raw terrain project files that the ADTs the client reads are built from (the internal editor's counterpart of an ADT, see [[ADT/v22]]). It was first seen in the <tt>wow_classic_beta</tt> build 1.60.1.69876 published on 2026-09-16, the first WoW: Forever build on Battle.net. It shares most chunk names with DAT versions 22 and 23 (documented at [[ADT/v22]] and [[ADT/v23]]), but it is a distinct version: <tt>MVER</tt> comes before <tt>AHDR</tt>, the version is 26, and it adds new chunks (<tt>ALOC</tt>, <tt>AOCH</tt>, <tt>ADST</tt>). The [[ADT/v22]] page also lists version 26 in its <tt>AHDR</tt> version comment.

Everything below was observed in 699 files from that build. Where a field's meaning is not yet known, the page gives the observed values instead of guessing. Field names carried over from the DAT v22/v23 documentation ([[ADT/v22]] / [[ADT/v23]]) are marked ''(v22 name)'' when they have not been verified for v26.

== Files ==
* The files ship without names: they are known only by FileDataID (observed range 6893600–6894299), with no extension. No WDT or listfile entry has been observed for them.
* A file's tile coordinates are '''not''' derived from its name; they are stored in the file itself (see [[#ALOC|ALOC]]).
* Chunks are standard little-endian IFF chunks (<tt>uint32 magic; uint32 size;</tt> payload) with no padding. All 699 files parse with no bytes left over.
* Of the 699 files, 30 have varying heights and 669 are completely flat; in 640 files every <tt>ACNK</tt> is header-only.
* The 30 tiles with terrain are the southwest corner of Tirisfal Glades.

== Chunk order ==
 MVER AHDR ALOC AOCH AVTX ANRM [ATEX × n] ADOO × n ACNK × 256 [ADST × n] ACVT
* <tt>ATEX</tt> is present in 30 files and absent in the other 669.
* <tt>ADST</tt> is present in 7 files, as a run of 2–139 chunks between the last <tt>ACNK</tt> and <tt>ACVT</tt>.

== MVER ==
 uint32_t version; // 26

== AHDR: HeaDeR ==
size: 0x40
 struct
 {
 /*0x00*/ uint32_t version;     // 26
 /*0x04*/ uint32_t vertices_x;  // 129
 /*0x08*/ uint32_t vertices_y;  // 129
 /*0x0C*/ uint32_t chunks_x;    // 16
 /*0x10*/ uint32_t chunks_y;    // 16
 /*0x14*/ uint32_t unknown;     // 8396383 (0x801E5F) in every observed file
 /*0x18*/ uint32_t unused[10];  // always 0
 } ahdr;

== ALOC ==
<span id="ALOC"></span>
New in v26. size: 0x14
 struct
 {
 /*0x00*/ uint32_t unknown;  // 2869 in every observed file
 /*0x04*/ uint32_t tile_x;   // observed 18..45
 /*0x08*/ uint32_t tile_y;   // observed 16..40
 /*0x0C*/ uint32_t tile_x2;  // equal to tile_x in every observed file
 /*0x10*/ uint32_t tile_y2;  // equal to tile_y in every observed file
 } aloc;
* Each file has a unique (<tt>tile_x</tt>, <tt>tile_y</tt>) pair.
* Checked with heights: for tiles whose <tt>tile_x</tt> differs by 1, the last column of one tile's outer <tt>AVTX</tt> grid is identical to the first column of the neighbour's. For <tt>tile_y</tt>, the same holds for rows (35 and 36 neighbour pairs, all exact matches; every other edge combination differs by hundreds of units).
* Why <tt>tile_x</tt>/<tt>tile_y</tt> are stored twice is unknown; possibly a min/max tile range.
* <tt>unknown</tt> (2869) is identical in every observed file, so it is not a per-tile index. It is not a FileDataID in the community listfile, and no <tt>Map</tt>, <tt>AreaTable</tt>, <tt>MapDifficulty</tt> or <tt>UiMap</tt> row in 1.60.1.69876 or 1.15.9.69722 contains it. Those <tt>Map</tt> tables have rows 2868 (Eastern Plaguelands (Scarlet Raid Phase)) and 2875 (Karazhan Crypts) but none for 2869–2874, so it may be the ID of a map that is not in the client's <tt>Map</tt> table.

== AOCH ==
New in v26. size: 0x800 (2048)
* All bytes are 0 in every observed file. Its meaning is unknown.

== AVTX: VerTeX ==
size: (vertices_x × vertices_y + (vertices_x − 1) × (vertices_y − 1)) × 4 = 132100
 float outer[ahdr.vertices_y][ahdr.vertices_x]; // 129 × 129, row-major
 float inner[ahdr.vertices_y - 1][ahdr.vertices_x - 1]; // 128 × 128
* In the outer grid, rows run along <tt>ALOC.tile_y</tt> and columns along <tt>ALOC.tile_x</tt> (from the shared edges described under [[#ALOC|ALOC]]).
* Heights match exactly across tile edges with no per-tile base height, so they are absolute at least at tile level (chunk edges inside a tile not yet checked).
* The inner grid order is assumed to match the outer grid but has not been verified.
* '''Units: heights are in inches.''' ADT heights are in yards, so DAT heights are 36 times finer (1 yard = 36 inches). Dividing by 36 gives ADT units: the lowest observed height, −18559.47, becomes −515.54, which matches the shipped ocean floor in the same area.
* The vertex grid has the same dimensions as an ADT tile's (129 × 129 outer + 128 × 128 inner), so the added precision is in the height values, not in the number of vertices.

== ANRM: NoRMals ==
size: (129 × 129 + 128 × 128) × 3 = 99075
 using Vec3c = int8_t[3];
 Vec3c outer[ahdr.vertices_y][ahdr.vertices_x];
 Vec3c inner[ahdr.vertices_y - 1][ahdr.vertices_x - 1];
* Component order is '''(column axis, vertical, row axis)''', the same order as <tt>ACDO</tt> positions; 127 is 1.0 (every observed vector has length 127).
* Checked against normals computed from <tt>AVTX</tt> (in inches): mean dot product 0.985, next-best component order 0.658.

== ATEX: TEXtures ==
* One chunk per texture filename, not a single string block. The name is '''not''' zero-terminated: the chunk size gives its length (216 of 216 observed chunks).
* 33 distinct textures across the files; for example <tt>Tileset\TirisFall\TirisFallRockyMudGrass.BLP</tt>.

== ADOO: DOOdad ==
* One chunk per model filename, not zero-terminated (159,600 of 159,600 observed chunks), 225 or 285 per file.
* The list is nearly identical in every file, including the flat ones. For example: <tt>WORLD\LORDAERON\SILVERPINE\PASSIVEDOODADS\TREES\SILVERPINETREE03.M2</tt>.

== ACNK: ChuNK ==
256 per file, in row-major order.
* 163840 of the observed <tt>ACNK</tt>s are exactly 0x40 bytes (header only). The rest continue with sub-chunks.
 struct
 {
 /*0x00*/ uint32_t index_x;   // i % 16 for the i-th ACNK in the file
 /*0x04*/ uint32_t index_y;   // i / 16
 /*0x08*/ uint32_t flags;     // 0xD000 in every observed chunk
 /*0x0C*/ uint32_t areaId;    // (v22 name) 0 in every observed chunk
 /*0x10*/ uint16_t holes_low_res;               // (v22 name) 0 in every observed chunk
 /*0x12*/ uint2_t  predominant_layer[8][8];     // layer index per cell, LSB first, row-major (see below)
 /*0x22*/ uint64_t unknown_mask;                // non-zero in 725 of 179200 chunks; MCNK keeps noEffectDoodad[8][8] at this spot
 /*0x2A*/ uint16_t unknown1;                    // 0 in every observed chunk
 /*0x2C*/ uint32_t unknown2;                    // 0 in every observed chunk
 /*0x30*/ uint8_t  unknown3[0x0C];              // almost always 0
 /*0x3C*/ uint32_t unknown4;                    // 0 in every observed chunk
 } acnk_header;
* <tt>predominant_layer</tt>: for 95.0% of 239,808 cells in chunks with layers it equals the layer that dominates the cell after blending the <tt>AMAP</tt>s (67.9% when every cell of a chunk is given its most common layer).
Sub-chunk order after the header:
 ALYR × 0..4, ASHD, ACDO × n

=== ALYR: LaYeR ===
size: 0x1028 (4136) for every observed layer: a 0x20 header followed by a nested <tt>AMAP</tt>.
 struct
 {
 /*0x00*/ int32_t  textureID;  // index into ATEX
 /*0x04*/ uint32_t flags;      // 0x100 on every observed layer, including the first
 /*0x08*/ uint32_t unused[6];  // always 0
 } alyr;

==== AMAP: alpha MAP ====
size: 0x1000 (4096) in every observed layer: an uncompressed 8-bit 64 × 64 map. Every layer has one, including the first.
* The values are per-layer '''blend weights''', not the sequential alpha of [[ADT/v18#MCAL_sub-chunk|MCAL]]: the maps of all layers of a chunk add up to 255 at each pixel (about 254.6 on average, exactly 255 for 74% of pixels).
* Check: the layer with the highest weight in each 8 × 8 cell matches <tt>ACNK.predominant_layer</tt> for 99.93% of 239,808 cells (95.03% if the maps are read as sequential alpha).
* To convert to sequential alpha for layer ''i'' ≥ 1: ''a<sub>i</sub>'' = ''w<sub>i</sub>'' / (''w<sub>0</sub>'' + … + ''w<sub>i</sub>'').

=== ASHD: SHaDow map ===
size: 0x200 (512). Present in every <tt>ACNK</tt> that has sub-chunks. Presumably 64 × 64 bits; every byte is 0 in all 15,360 observed <tt>ASHD</tt> chunks.

=== ACDO: Chunk - Definitions of Objects ===
size: 0x38 (5298 observed) or 0x3C (11 observed, all WMOs). Zero or more per chunk.
 struct
 {
 /*0x00*/ uint32_t modelid;          // index into ADOO
 /*0x04*/ float    position[3];      // inches: [0] column axis and [2] row axis from the centre of this ACNK (±600),
                                     //         [1] vertical from the mean of this chunk's 145 AVTX heights
 /*0x10*/ float    rotation[3];      // degrees, same axis order as position ([1] is about the vertical)
 /*0x1C*/ float    scale;            // 0.1 .. 3.47
 /*0x20*/ float    unknown0;         // 1.0 in every observed record
 /*0x24*/ uint32_t unknown1;         // 0 in every observed record
 /*0x28*/ float    unknown2;         // mostly 0
 /*0x2C*/ uint32_t uniqueId;
 /*0x30*/ uint32_t extra_count;      // 0, or 1 in the 0x3C records
 /*0x34*/ uint32_t unknown3;         // 0, 1, 2, 3 or 0x10000
 /*0x38*/ uint32_t extra[extra_count]; // 1 or 2
 } acdo;
* Frame check: with this frame, object heights match the terrain under them with a median difference of 0.31 inches (p90 2.37 in); moving each object to a random chunk gives 103.9 inches.
* A chunk is 1200 inches wide (33.33 yards), so the ±600 range of position[0] and position[2] is half a chunk.

== ADST ==
New in v26. size: 0x0C. It appears only in some files, as a run after the last <tt>ACNK</tt>.
 struct
 {
 uint32_t uniqueId;    // same value range as ACDO.uniqueId
 uint32_t fileDataID;  // a model, e.g. 190719 = World/critter/BIRDS/Bird01.m2
 uint32_t unknown;     // 1
 } adst;
* 321 rows in 7 files; every <tt>fileDataID</tt> is a model in the community listfile.
* No <tt>ADST.uniqueId</tt> matches an <tt>ACDO.uniqueId</tt> in the observed files, and the rows carry no position.

== ACVT: VerTex shading ==
size: (129 × 129 + 128 × 128) × 4 = 132100. Present in every observed file.
* One 4-byte colour per vertex, outer grid then inner grid, as in [[ADT/v23]]. Three bytes are centred on 127 (neutral, as in MCCV) and the fourth is always 255. Which of the first and third bytes is red is not known: almost every observed value is neutral.

== Open questions ==
* <tt>AHDR</tt> +0x14 (8396383), <tt>ALOC.unknown</tt> (2869), and why <tt>ALOC</tt> repeats the tile coordinates.
* <tt>AOCH</tt> (all zero), and why no <tt>ADST.uniqueId</tt> matches an <tt>ACDO</tt>.
* The inner <tt>AVTX</tt>/<tt>ANRM</tt> grid order and the <tt>ACVT</tt> red/blue order.
* <tt>ACNK</tt> +0x22, the <tt>ASHD</tt> bit layout (all zero so far), and <tt>ACDO</tt> unknown0..3.
